propositions: The DC transport is missing twelve methods that the core reconciler requires, causing crashes on write paths (set_entity_property) and silent degradation on other paths (comments, links, parent, properties, assignee validation)
Seven of the twelve absent methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions, so their absence produces silent sync failures rather than detectable errors
The port (TicketTransport Protocol) declares only six members but the core actually calls twenty-one distinct transport methods, leaving the contract misdescribed
DC reporter sync churns forever because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId (absent on DC), causing _diff_reporter to re-emit the mutation on every pass even after a successful write

The DC transport must absorb idempotent 404/409 responses internally rather than rely on Cloud-specific exception handlers, and must use DC REST v2 offset pagination for get_parent_map rather than Cloud v3 cursor pagination
